title: Down Payment Room Share by Base-Loan-to-Value, Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant
content:
**Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant — share of the down payment room by base-loan-to-value**

The down payment room of a Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant is worked out in this order: first the part of the reserve kept in the down payment is taken from the down payment, never below zero; then that amount is multiplied by the share for the file's base-loan-to-value; the product is rounded down to the whole dollar.

The base-loan-to-value is the base loan amount as a percent of the property value, both as recorded on the borrower's Mortgage Loan File.

| Base-loan-to-value | Share of the amount |
|---|---|
| above 95 percent | 75 percent |
| above 90 and at most 95 percent | 90 percent |
| 90 percent or below | the whole amount |

### Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical files)

| Property value | Base loan amount | Base-loan-to-value | Share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 300000.00 | 270000.00 | 90.00 percent | the whole amount |
| 300000.00 | 270030.00 | 90.01 percent | 90 percent |
| 300000.00 | 285000.00 | 95.00 percent | 90 percent |
| 300000.00 | 285030.00 | 95.01 percent | 75 percent |

### Worked example (hypothetical)

Down payment 14970.00, part of the reserve kept in it 1000.00: the amount is 13970.00. At a base-loan-to-value of 95.01 percent the share is 75 percent, giving 10477.50, rounded down to the whole dollar: a down payment room of 10477.00. At 92 percent the share is 90 percent: 12573.00. At 88 percent the whole amount: 13970.00.
